sentence: Builds superconducting detectors that try to catch light dark matter particles deep underground.
Develops a 3D printed tube and band, later resorbed by the body, to stop leaks where two ends of intestine are sewn.
Builds a model that links brain cells to whole-brain activity and uses it to study autism.
Tries to settle conjectures in combinatorics and uses AI with Lean to produce formally-verified proofs.
Builds a system that uses deep learning to write radiology reports from chest x-rays and electronic health records.
Develops gars as research animals, with better spawning and gene editing methods, to help study vertebrate evolution.
Builds a small portable sensor that uses magnetic resonance to measure iohexol in blood samples, to check kidney function.
Tries to find out how a small set of signaling molecules reach exactly the right cells, and builds models that predict how cells respond.
Studies how sea urchin and sea star larvae respond to bacteria and viruses by measuring gene expression in single cells.
Studies how modifications of DNA and its proteins reset gene expression when egg and sperm cells fuse in plants, especially rice.
Tries to make post-quantum cryptographic algorithms faster and safer on graphics processing units, microcontrollers and other hardware.
Develops a way to make ion lens elements that handle extremely high electric fields for an imaging mass spectrometer without failing from electrostatic discharge.
Develops methods that let classical and quantum computers work together to estimate the ground-state energy of molecules.
Tests whether sensory hair cell organs called neuromasts cause bone to form in specific regions of the face.
Tries to use sulfated polysaccharides on nanoparticles to collect inflammatory cytokines and evade immune recognition.
Develops and tests practical solutions for saltwater intrusion, which turns coastal farmland and forest into marsh.
Builds a machine that uses a laser to fuse optical fiber to a chip, making photonic devices cheaper to package.
